title: Add EUDR certification information
summary: Sustainability Management: Add EUDR certification information. Announced, GA 2026-11 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Record EUDR certification information for items under the EU Deforestation Regulation. Different lots of the same item can carry different certificates, origins and validity, it is stored on Lot No. Information, not on the item. An item is opted in with a single EUDR Relevant flag on the Item Card, which enforces lot tracking with lot information. Certificate data can be printed on a new EUDR Sales Invoice.

title: More countries and languages
summary: Expense Agent: More countries and languages. In preview, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Expense Agent supports more languages and regions, enabling an experience for users in all countries/regions where Business Central is available, and adding the following languages: Czech, Dutch, Finnish, Icelandic, Italian, Norwegian, and Swedish.

title: Add date ranges and vehicle types in your mileage calculation
summary: Expense Agent: Add date ranges and vehicle types in your mileage calculation. In preview, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Expense Agent now supports advanced mileage rate configuration based on both effective date ranges and vehicle types, enabling more flexible and accurate mileage reimbursement calculations. This enhancement combines mileage rate scheduling with support for differentiated vehicle categories.

title: AI-Driven Approvals
summary: Expense Agent: AI-Driven Approvals. In preview, GA 2026-12 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Expense Agent can validate submitted expense reports against approval policies written in natural language and provide approvers with guidance during the review process. After an employee submits an expense report, the system evaluates both the overall report and the individual expense lines to detect potential policy violations, suspicious patterns, or situations that might require closer attention.

title: Create expenses from credit card feeds
summary: Expense Agent: Create expenses from credit card feeds. Announced, GA 2026-12 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Expense Agent now supports creating expenses from imported credit card transaction feeds or automatically reconcile with them if the expense was created earlier. Key capabilities include: Import credit card transaction data and review it in the web and mobile apps. Automatically create expenses from imported card transactions. Match imported transactions to existing expenses, where applicable.

title: Create expense reports per trip automatically
summary: Expense Agent: Create expense reports per trip automatically. Announced, GA 2026-11 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Expense Agent can automatically create expense reports based on identified business trips. You just need to configure the feature on the Expense Agent Setup page. Instead of manually collecting and organizing individual expense entries, you can use the agent to group relevant expenses and generate a dedicated expense report for each trip. Key capabilities include: Administrators can specify whether the company wants to group expenses by trip and not only by period.

title: Improve duplicates prevention
summary: Expense Agent: Improve duplicates prevention. In preview, GA 2026-12 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Expense Agent can identify and handle duplicated expense submissions. Key capabilities include: Enhanced duplicate detection that identifies expenses with matching or highly similar details, such as amount, date, merchant, receipt, or transaction information. Proactive guidance that alerts employees when it detects a potential duplicate expense in the current expense report, or one that is already posted.

title: Use assigned projects only in the web app
summary: Expense Agent: Use assigned projects only in the web app. In preview, GA 2026-12 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Expense Agent web app now uses dedicated resource assignments for projects to determine which projects are available to each user when they create or manage expense entries. Key capabilities include: You can assign dedicated resources (employees) to the whole project or to the specific task. Display only projects or/and tasks where the user is assigned as a resource. Automatically filter project lists based on project-resource relationships.

title: Add an interim approver when you submit an expense report
summary: Expense Agent: Add an interim approver when you submit an expense report. Announced, GA 2026-11 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). This feature introduces support for a simple interim approval scenario for expense reports. When someone submits an expense report, organizations can designate an interim approver to review and approve expenses before the final approver can review and approve. Interim approver must review expense reports to confirm whether they're complete and compliant before final approver.

title: Use Expense Manager role center
summary: Expense Agent: Use Expense Manager role center. Announced, GA 2026-12 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). The Expense Manager Role Center is updated to provide a more focused and efficient experience for managing vendor and expense-related activities. The enhancements align the workspace with typical expense management workflows, ensuring that key information and actions are readily accessible. Where relevant, other Role Centers are also updated to include access to expense management features.

title: Calculate and report VAT based on expense reports
summary: Expense Agent: Calculate and report VAT based on expense reports. In preview, GA 2026-12 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Expense Agent supports automated VAT handling for expense reports, which can help simplify tax management and improve reporting accuracy. Key capabilities include: Automatic VAT Calculation : Expense Agent identifies VAT-relevant expense transactions and calculates applicable VAT amounts based on the information in submitted expense reports.

title: Use approvals with fixed asset journals
summary: Finance: Use approvals with fixed asset journals. Announced, GA 2026-11 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Organizations can use approval workflows with Fixed Asset Journals , which gives them the same level of control and oversight for fixed assets that's available for other journals in Business Central.

title: Use batch totals for payment journals
summary: Finance: Use batch totals for payment journals. Announced, GA 2026-11 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). The Batch Total field on the Payment Journal page enhances payment processing by enabling you to work with and review a cumulative total for a payment journal batch. By surfacing batch-level totals directly in payment journals, organizations gain better control over outgoing payments and can streamline review and approval processes.

title: Expense Agent mobile app
summary: Expense Agent mobile app. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). The Expense Agent mobile app for Dynamics 365 Business Central extends expense capture to iOS and Android mobile devices by enabling employees to submit receipts directly from their phone or using native share functionality. Employees can take a photo of a receipt with their phone camera or select an existing image or document, and share it with Expense Agent mobile app. They can also capture multiple receipts directly from the mobile app and process them automatically.

title: Calculate withholding tax automatically in expense reports
summary: Expense Agent: Calculate withholding tax automatically in expense reports. In preview, GA 2027-04 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Organizations can automatically calculate employee withholding taxes (WHT) as part of the expense report process. When employees submit expenses that are subject to withholding tax requirements, the system applies the appropriate tax calculations directly within the expense report workflow. Key capabilities include: Automatic withholding tax calculation for employee expense transactions that require tax deductions.

title: Exchange EDI documents
summary: E-Documents: Exchange EDI documents. In preview, GA 2027-04 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). This feature extends the E-Documents framework to support Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), which enables organizations to exchange business documents electronically with vendors and partners using widely adopted industry standards. Key capabilities include: Leverage the existing E-Documents framework as a unified platform for managing electronic document exchange. Enable organizations to send and receive structured business documents without relying on paper-based or manual processes.

title: Calculate multiple excise duties per item
summary: Finance: Calculate multiple excise duties per item. In preview, GA 2027-01 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). This feature enhances excise tax management by allowing multiple excise duty definitions to be associated with a single item and calculated during transactions. Key capabilities include: Assign multiple excise duty configurations to the same inventory item (i.e, item is liable for both plastic and sugar tax). Automatically calculate all applicable excise duties during purchasing and vendor-related transactions.

title: Vendor specific number series for Self-billing Invoices
summary: Finance: Vendor specific number series for Self-billing Invoices. In preview, GA 2027-01 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Organizations that use self-billing often need to follow supplier-specific invoicing requirements, including unique numbering conventions. With this enhancement, users can define and assign dedicated number series for self-billed purchase invoices on a per-vendor basis. Key capabilities include: Set up a unique number series for individual vendors that participate in self-billing arrangements.

title: Use withholding taxes (WHT) with employee transactions
summary: Finance: Use withholding taxes (WHT) with employee transactions. In preview, GA 2027-01 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). This feature extends withholding tax capabilities to include employee transactions. The feature supports scenarios where employee-related payments or reimbursements are subject to withholding tax requirements and ensures that you accurately process the transactions in the financial system. Key capabilities include: Apply withholding tax rules to employee transactions. Automatically calculate withholding tax amounts based on configured tax setups.

title: Run data queries with MCP Server
summary: Copilot and agents: Run data queries with MCP Server. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Use new MCP tools to define, validate, and run custom data queries. Your MCP application can then query data for which no existing APIs exist.

title: Actions on reports and pages can now inherit tooltips
summary: Development: Actions on reports and pages can now inherit tooltips. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Tooltips on page or report objects are now inherited into actions that run those pages. This means you only need to write descriptive tooltips in one place and have it propagated out to all usage of the object.

title: AL developers can turn indexes on/off in AL code.
summary: Development: AL developers can turn indexes on/off in AL code.. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). AL developers can now turn indexes off/on from AL code. This allows app publishers to ship index management to match their features.

title: Developers can define indexes that span fields from a base table and its table extensions
summary: Development: Developers can define indexes that span fields from a base table and its table extensions. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). The new data model for storing fields from table extensions allows developers to define keys across fields from the base table and table extensions.

title: Administrators can turn SIFT indexes on/off
summary: Governance and administration: Administrators can turn SIFT indexes on/off. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Administrators can now turn SIFT indexes on/off directly in the Business Central application.

title: Monitor usage of Open in Excel with telemetry
summary: Governance and administration: Monitor usage of Open in Excel with telemetry. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Logging Open in Excel actions to telemetry makes data export events auditable, which can be critical for compliance, security investigations, and understanding how customers use Business Central.

title: Automate report outputs
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Automate report outputs. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Use new APIs on the report inbox to extend automation with Power Automate or MCP to reports.

title: Bookmark list views and analysis tabs
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Bookmark list views and analysis tabs. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Bookmark analysis tabs and list views to your role center and/or incorporate them into profiles.

title: Control the lifecycle of all report layouts
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Control the lifecycle of all report layouts. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Set status on all types of layouts (including layouts shipped with Business Central, per-tenant extensions, and AppSource apps) to control which layouts are available to end users.

title: Reduce complexity of report datasets
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Reduce complexity of report datasets. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Word layouts now include a company information dataitem that is shared across all report datasets. This reduces the work needed for a report developer and standardizes how company information is used across report layouts.

title: Use system audit fields in analysis mode and in profiles
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Use system audit fields in analysis mode and in profiles. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Use system audit fields in analysis tabs and add them directly to pages in profiles.

title: Run multiple financial reports and get a single PDF output
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Run multiple financial reports and get a single PDF output. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Define report packs that contain multiple financial reports, and then run them immediately or schedule delivery to report inboxes or by email.

title: Trace G/L account usage in finance reports
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Trace G/L account usage in finance reports. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Financial report authors can now identify uncategorized accounts, trace account usage and calculations, and preview definitions before publishing.

title: Financial report changes are now always logged
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Financial report changes are now always logged. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Changes to financial row, column, and report definitions are automatically recorded in the change log for easier auditing.

title: Reuse header/footer layouts across document reports
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Reuse header/footer layouts across document reports. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). With the new composable layouts feature, you can apply a header/footer on layouts to get consistent look and feel on the PDF output. It is possible to set defaults on a global level, per company, per report, or per layout, giving the administrator full flexibility of theming.

title: Brand document reports with report themes
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Brand document reports with report themes. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). With the new composable layouts feature, you can apply a report theme on layouts to get consistent look and feel on the PDF output. It is possible to set defaults on a global level, per company, per report, or per layout, giving the administrator full flexibility of theming.

title: Design document reports with the updated Word add-in
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Design document reports with the updated Word add-in. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Use new design components in the Word add-in to layout your document report layouts. We have added design controls for common document report parts, such as Addresses Field groups Amounts Signature lines Notes

title: Use conditional visibility in the updated Word add-in
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Use conditional visibility in the updated Word add-in. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Design document reports layouts with conditional visibility using the new HideIf logic control in the Word add-in. The control can use boolean fields in the dataset to handle visibility of the content inside.

title: Design document report themes with the updated Word add-in
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Design document report themes with the updated Word add-in. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Design document report themes using the new document samples controls in the Word add-in. We have added samples that look like common document types, such as invoice pick list outstanding orders.

title: Design header/footer layouts for document reports with the updated Word add-in
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Design header/footer layouts for document reports with the updated Word add-in. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Design document report header/footer layouts using the new header and/or footer document samples controls in the Word add-in. We have addes samples that can be used for internal or external reports.

title: Faster data loading with improved data model for table extensions
summary: Service and platform: Faster data loading with improved data model for table extensions. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). With the new data model for table extensions, all fields on an AL table are stored in the same table in the database. This gives faster performance on all database operations that involve table extensions.

title: Build extensible and data-driven AL test suites
summary: Development: Build extensible and data-driven AL test suites. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Create parameterized AL tests from reusable data sources, and attach lifecycle handlers for shared setup, cleanup, logging, measurement, and test reporting. Business value: Developers can build more maintainable AL test suites by separating reusable test data and lifecycle behavior from individual test procedures.

title: Run AL tests from command-line and CI/CD workflows
summary: Development: Run AL tests from command-line and CI/CD workflows. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Use ALTool to compile, deploy, and run AL test projects from scripts or pipelines, with structured JSON results for test methods and pass, fail, and skip counts. Business value: Development teams can run AL tests directly from automated build and release pipelines without depending on the MCP server or a manually operated test client.

title: Profile slow Business Central sessions with AI agents
summary: Development: Profile slow Business Central sessions with AI agents. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Let an AI agent schedule profiling for a Business Central session, collect CPU and memory data, identify costly AL paths, and summarize SQL and HTTP activity. Business value: Developers and administrators can investigate slow Business Central sessions with help from an AI agent instead of manually collecting and interpreting performance profiles.

title: Audit AL app accessibility and debugging boundaries
summary: Development: Audit AL app accessibility and debugging boundaries. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Build and query static AL call graphs to trace public-to-internal calls, debugging boundaries, elevated code, and cross-app relationships, with visual exports. Business value: Extension developers can understand how public APIs expose internal implementation details and where execution crosses debugging boundaries.

title: Get clearer guidance for AL object structure
summary: Development: Get clearer guidance for AL object structure. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Use compiler diagnostic AL0926 to identify AL object sections declared in the wrong order instead of interpreting multiple secondary and less specific parser errors. Business value: Developers and coding agents receive a direct explanation when sections of an AL object are declared in the wrong order. The clearer diagnostic reduces time spent interpreting secondary parser errors and makes automated code generation easier to correct."

title: Use AL language intelligence from AI agents and other editors
summary: Development: Use AL language intelligence from AI agents and other editors. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Run the standalone AL language server to provide completion, navigation, references, rename, formatting, and other project-aware LSP features outside Visual Studio Code. Business value: Teams can use full AL language intelligence in AI coding agents and development environments that support the Language Server Protocol (LSP), without requiring Visual Studio Code as the client.

title: Discover objects in connected Business Central environments
summary: Development: Discover objects in connected Business Central environments. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Search objects installed in a connected Business Central environment, including owning-app metadata needed to add dependencies and download the correct symbols. Business value: Developers and coding agents can discover AL objects that are installed in the target Business Central environment even when the corresponding symbols haven't yet been downloaded into the workspace.

title: Control sales document creation for Shopify orders and returns
summary: Ecommerce: Control sales document creation for Shopify orders and returns. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Value Set Use Shopify Order No. and Process Returns as on the Shopify Shop Card, then review contacts before you choose Create Sales Document. Details The Shopify connector gives you more control before it creates sales documents. Although the connector already stores the Shopify order number in dedicated fields on sales documents, using the same document number in Shopify and Business Central can improve traceability across both systems even more.

title: Keep Shopify connections current
summary: Ecommerce: Keep Shopify connections current. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Value Shopify regularly retires API versions. Staying current helps prevent avoidable connection interruptions and keeps synchronization compatible with Shopify platform changes. Better operational cues and clearer timestamps help administrators find failures faster and understand whether a value came from Shopify or Business Central. Details Shopify releases a new API version every three months at the beginning of the quarter, and supports each version for 12 months.

title: Manage Shopify B2B companies, catalogs, and pricing
summary: Ecommerce: Manage Shopify B2B companies, catalogs, and pricing. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Value Shopify expanded core B2B capabilities to all plans, and the Shopify connector supports company synchronization, B2B order processing, and market catalogs across those plans. The latest improvements make tax identifiers, company records, and catalog pricing easier to configure and help prevent conflicting price synchronization.

title: Process Shopify order changes, exchanges, and refunds
summary: Ecommerce: Process Shopify order changes, exchanges, and refunds. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Value Keep edited and exchanged Shopify orders aligned when you create sales documents and process refunds. Details When a Shopify return includes a replacement item, the connector imports the returned item and the exchange item together and adds them to a sales credit memo or sales return order. You can keep both items on the same document or move the exchange item to a new sales document.

title: Synchronize tariff numbers and origin values with Shopify
summary: Ecommerce: Synchronize tariff numbers and origin values with Shopify. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Value Accurate tariff numbers and country/region of origin values support international shipping and customs reporting. Synchronizing these values with Shopify reduces duplicate data entry and helps keep product trade data consistent across both systems Details Turn on Sync HS Code and Country/Region of Origin on the Shopify Shop Card to synchronize tariff numbers and country or region of origin values between Business Central and Shopify.

title: Carry subcontracting instructions into purchase orders
summary: Supply Chain Management: Carry subcontracting instructions into purchase orders. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Value Subcontractors need clear instructions about the work they must perform. Reentering that information on purchase orders takes time and can introduce differences between the routing, production order, and purchasing documents. Details Subcontracting comments and attachments now follow the operation into the purchase order.

title: Let agents allocate free AL object IDs
summary: Development: Let agents allocate free AL object IDs. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Let coding agents find available IDs for AL objects and extension objects within project ranges, reducing manual range checks and collisions with existing project objects. Note that only IDs in connected environment are considered. Business value: Coding agents can scaffold AL objects without manually reading ID ranges or risking collisions with objects already declared in the project. This makes generated code more reliable and reduces the corrections needed before it compiles."

title: Post direct transfer orders from warehouse-enabled locations
summary: Supply Chain Management: Post direct transfer orders from warehouse-enabled locations. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Value Direct transfers move inventory between locations without using an in-transit location. You can use this simpler transfer method when the source location requires outbound warehouse handling, while preserving the picking and shipment controls configured for that location. Details Previously, one setting on the Inventory Setup page controlled how Business Central posted all direct transfers.

title: Configure AL MCP workspaces dynamically
summary: Development: Configure AL MCP workspaces dynamically. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Start the AL MCP server without a predefined project, add AL projects at runtime, and use configured connection details in headless scenarios without authentication prompts. Business value: AI-agent hosts can start a reusable AL MCP server before the target project is known, then load projects as work begins. This supports flexible agent sessions, shared tooling configurations, and headless automation without requiring a separate server process for every preconfigured workspace."

title: Diagnose AL MCP server activity with file logging
summary: Development: Diagnose AL MCP server activity with file logging. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Write AL MCP server diagnostics to a configurable file, select the appropriate detail level for troubleshooting, or turn file logging off when it isn't required. Business value: Developers and administrators can retain AL MCP server diagnostics for troubleshooting intermittent failures and reviewing agent activity. Configurable verbosity helps capture detailed information during investigation without permanently producing excessive logs."

title: Reduce manual work in quality tests and inspections
summary: Supply Chain Management: Reduce manual work in quality tests and inspections. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Value The Quality Management extension helps you include quality checks in receiving, production, assembly, and inventory processes. We improved several parts of the experience so that inspectors and quality managers can complete routine tasks with fewer interruptions.

title: Track AL compiler diagnostics in automated builds
summary: Development: Track AL compiler diagnostics in automated builds. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Have ALTool workspace builds write structured, project-specific compiler error logs that automated systems can retain, analyze, and use for code-quality tracking. Business value: Development teams can retain structured compiler and analyzer results from workspace builds, making it easier to track code-quality regressions and integrate AL diagnostics with automated alerting and reporting systems."

title: Evolve AL interfaces with default implementations
summary: Development: Evolve AL interfaces with default implementations. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Add default method bodies to AL interfaces so existing implementors continue working, then use RequiredPending and analyzer rules to introduce required methods safely. Business value: Extension publishers can add behavior to an interface without immediately requiring every implementing extension to change.

title: Set up and explore subcontracting more easily
summary: Supply Chain Management: Set up and explore subcontracting more easily. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Value Subcontracting requires coordinated setup across work centers, vendors, locations, prices, and production BOMs. A guided starting point and actionable warnings help administrators find the required setup and correct missing information before it interrupts production work. Details Clearer demonstration data also makes it easier to evaluate intermediate and final subcontracting operations and compare more than one subcontractor.

title: Access application links through ModuleInfo
summary: Development: Access application links through ModuleInfo. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Read help, EULA, privacy statement, and locale-aware context-sensitive help links from an app manifest at runtime through additional ModuleInfo properties. Business value: Extensions can surface application-specific help, legal, and privacy resources dynamically instead of duplicating links in code. Context-sensitive help can also respect the current user's locale, improving support experiences for multilingual deployments."

title: Use inventory put-aways and picks for subcontracting
summary: Supply Chain Management: Use inventory put-aways and picks for subcontracting. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Value Companies that use basic warehouse configurations can include subcontracting in the same inventory activities they use for other inbound and outbound work. Warehouse employees can process subcontracted output without switching to warehouse receipts, and production teams can move work-in-process items (WIP items) between locations without treating them as physical inventory.

title: Simplify AL extension setup and authentication in Visual Studio Code
summary: Development: Simplify AL extension setup and authentication in Visual Studio Code. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Automatically acquire the required .NET runtime and use Visual Studio Code authentication by default, reducing manual setup across local and browser-hosted environments. Business value: AL developers spend less time installing runtimes and managing separate authentication prompts when setting up Visual Studio Code. The AL extension is also smaller because it no longer includes separate runtime copies for each supported operating system.

title: Restrict global symbol resolution to a minor version
summary: Development: Restrict global symbol resolution to a minor version. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Configure global symbol downloads to remain within the major and minor version in app.json while still selecting the newest available patch for all dependencies. Business value: Development teams can make symbol restoration more predictable by preventing dependencies from moving to a newer minor release unexpectedly. This helps reproduce builds and test extensions against the intended Business Central minor version while still receiving compatible patch updates."

title: Work more efficiently with manufacturing documents and capacity calendars
summary: Supply Chain Management: Work more efficiently with manufacturing documents and capacity calendars. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Value Planners and production managers often move between planning worksheets, production orders, work and machine centers, production BOMs, and routings to complete routine work. Small gaps in page actions, fields, filtering, and error navigation add unnecessary steps and can delay production scheduling. Details These improvements place manufacturing information and actions closer to the records where you work.

title: Translate objects with the same name in different namespaces
summary: Development: Translate objects with the same name in different namespaces. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Generate namespace-aware translation identifiers so identically named AL objects can be translated independently while existing non-namespaced translations remain valid. Business value: Extension developers can translate objects independently when those objects have the same name but belong to different namespaces. This avoids translation identifier collisions and supports broader adoption of namespaces in existing apps."

title: Check records for uncommitted changes
summary: Development: Check records for uncommitted changes. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Use the Record API IsDirty property to determine whether a record instance contains unsaved changes before deciding to validate, save, or otherwise process it. Business value: AL developers can determine whether a record instance has been changed before deciding to save it, validate it, or prompt the user. This can simplify conditional persistence and reduce unnecessary database operations."

title: Debug recorded Business Central failures with an AI agent
summary: Development: Debug recorded Business Central failures with an AI agent. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). "Describe a failing scenario to an AI agent, record the next matching Business Central session or a known session, and collect its snapshot for offline AL debugging. Business value: Developers can investigate intermittent or production-only AL failures by describing the problem to an AI agent and reproducing the scenario, without manually configuring and operating the snapshot debugger.

title: Enable Microsoft Copilot chat experience
summary: Copilot and agents: Enable Microsoft Copilot chat experience. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). The updated Microsoft Copilot chat experience introduces a modern, consistent, and intuitive interface that aligns Business Central with the broader Microsoft Copilot ecosystem. The enhancement modernizes the chat panel, streamlines navigation, and improves user workflows by adopting familiar interaction patterns from Microsoft Copilot.

title: Manage tasks from all agents in dedicated task pane
summary: Copilot and agents: Manage tasks from all agents in dedicated task pane. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). This feature introduces a dedicated task pane in Business Central that displays all tasks generated by the agents. The task pane appears as an additional panel in the user interface and can be opened from anywhere in Business Central. Tasks include suggestions, validations, follow‑ups access to draft documents, and other agent‑initiated actions. Users can review task details, navigate directly to the affected record, complete tasks, or dismiss them.

title: Show avatars for record creators and modifiers in list
summary: Copilot and agents: Show avatars for record creators and modifiers in list. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). This feature introduces visual avatars in Business Central list pages to indicate which user or agent created or last modified a record. The capability enhances traceability and supports collaborative work by making identity information immediately visible without opening the record. The avatars reflect either a named Business Central user, a system user or an AI agent, following the existing identity model.

title: Map new Dataverse fields in Business Central
summary: Adapt faster with Power Platform: Map new Dataverse fields in Business Central. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). This feature simplifies how administrators keep Business Central and Dataverse aligned as Dataverse schemas evolve. Previously, exposing new or existing custom Dataverse fields required creating or updating a table extension (PTE) in the integration layer. Based on partner and customer feedback, this update removes that dependency.

title: Review content generated by agents directly on pages
summary: Copilot and agents: Review content generated by agents directly on pages. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). This improvement introduces the ability for Business Central users to review and approve content generated by agents directly on the pages where they work. You no longer need to navigate to separate task pane to understand that a given document was created by an agent. Instead, agent‑generated suggestions—such as descriptions, text proposals, or field‑specific updates—appear inline where they can be evaluated and modified before being applied.

title: Preview images directly in web client
summary: User experience: Preview images directly in web client. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). You can open image attachments in the Business Central web client without downloading the images first. Files display in preview mode with an easy to use viewer experience that's similar to the print preview or PDF preview features. If you want to save a copy, you can download the image file from the viewer. This feature works across all areas of Business Central, including agents, email, and code from extensions.

title: Show recently used in lookups
summary: User experiences: Show recently used in lookups. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Central now highlights recently used records directly in lookup dialogs. When users open a lookup, the system surfaces records they have recently accessed or worked with, making it easier to select the correct value without performing a search. The suggestions are personalized to each user and are based on usage signals already collected by the platform.

title: Agent actions review notifications on lists
summary: User experiences: Agent actions review notifications on lists. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Show and manage documents where agents require human interaction by using a new review bar on documents and lists.

title: Manage agent permissions easier
summary: Copilot and agents: Manage agent permissions easier. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Assign additional permissions to agents when they request them.

title: Show recently searched in Tell Me
summary: User experiences: Show recently searched in Tell Me. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Find pages and reports faster by accessing recent searches in Tell Me (Alt+Q).

title: Updates to Agent UI experience
summary: Copilot and agents: Updates to Agent UI experience. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Manage agents more easily by grouping avatars and using a dedicated action to start new tasks.

title: Use formulas to calculate emissions in purchase documents
summary: Sustainability Management: Use formulas to calculate emissions in purchase documents. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). This feature introduces formula-based emission calculations on purchase documents and uses the same calculation logic as sustainability journals. It applies emission factors to inputs such as fuel, electricity, distance, or custom amounts. Set up this feature on the Sustainability Setup page: First, turn on the Use Emissions in Purchase Documents toggle. Then, turn on the Use Formulas in Purchase Documents toggle.

title: Estimate your carbon footprint in Service Management
summary: Sustainabilty Management: Estimate your carbon footprint in Service Management. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). This feature extends sustainability tracking to cover Service Management features by displaying carbon footprint values on service documents. Emission data comes from sustainability value entries for items and from resource cards for resource-related emissions. When you consume or ship items or resources as part of a service order, the system retrieves their associated CO₂e values from sustainability data.

title: Reverse Sustainability Ledger entries transaction
summary: Sustainability Management: Reverse Sustainability Ledger entries transaction. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Keep your sustainability data accurate by reversing sustainability ledger entries that contain mistakes. If you post sustainability transactions that contain a mistake, you can’t delete the entries. However, if you posted the entries from a sustainability journal or a general journal, what you can do is use the Reverse Transaction action on the Sustainability Ledger Entries page to reverse them.

title: Track your carbon footprint for fixed assets
summary: Sustainability Management: Track your carbon footprint for fixed assets. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). This feature extends sustainability tracking to fixed assets by introducing fields and logic that capture emissions during acquisition, reclassification, and disposal. Emission data flows into the sustainability ledger and integrates with existing sustainability reporting. Validation ensures you can enter emissions only for acquisition transactions. Posting rules maintain data integrity across your fixed asset and sustainability ledgers.

title: Track your carbon footprint with item journals and item reclassification journals
summary: Sustainability Management: Track your carbon footprint with item journals and item reclassification journals. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). This feature introduces carbon footprint tracking to Item Journals and Item Reclassification Journals . It adds fields for CO₂e per unit and total CO₂e, and calculates emissions to ensure that emissions follow the same lifecycle logic as item costs. Emissions are calculated based on Sustainability Value Entries by using the Average or the new Specific method. Posting results are recorded in Sustainability Value Entries only.

title: Use specific method for carbon footprint calculation when enabling item tracking
summary: Sustainability Management: Use specific method for carbon footprint calculation when enabling item tracking. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). This feature introduces a new calculation method for carbon footprint tracking in sustainability value entries. In addition to the current Average method, you can enable a Specific method for items that you track with serial or lot numbers.

title: Improve purchase order matching in Payables Agent
summary: Copilot and agents: Improve purchase order matching in Payables Agent. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). This feature improves PO matching quality in Payables Agent and aligns draft finalization behavior with existing posting controls. The agent uses an enriched PO Lines list page during matching that includes these fields: Line Amount — enables matching on value, not just description and quantity. This field is especially valuable for service lines where quantity (often just 1) isn't a meaningful discriminator.

title: Page Scripting enters General Availability
summary: Development: Page Scripting enters General Availability. Generally available, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). The page scripting tool that can be used to record and replay user actions directly in the Business Central web client is moving out of preview to general availability. Thus the tool is fully localized and includes accessibility, usability, and visual improvements. We have also added new capabilitites to select multiple rows in grids and validate text displayed in message and error dialogs.

title: Data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric
summary: Data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric. Announced, GA 2027-04 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Connect Business Central to Microsoft Fabric to make business data available for analytics, reporting, and data integration. Choose the Business Central companies and tables to synchronise, and make the data available in OneLake for use with Fabric IQ, Power BI, Data Factory, and other analytics experiences. Get started quickly with ready-made sample Power BI apps, while built-in logging provides visibility into synchronisation health and helps troubleshoot issues.

title: [US] Match Shopify tax lines to tax jurisdictions
summary: Ecommerce: [US] Match Shopify tax lines to tax jurisdictions. In preview, GA 2027-04 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Value Reduce repetitive tax setup when you import Shopify orders that contain multiple United States tax jurisdictions. Shopify Tax Matching suggests how free-text tax lines map to configured tax jurisdictions and keeps you in control of exceptions before you create sales documents. Details The Shopify Tax Matching capability is available in public preview for organizations in the United States that use the Shopify connector.

title: Start using the new non-deductible VAT framework in Belgium
summary: Country and regional: Start using the new non-deductible VAT framework in Belgium. Announced, GA 2027-02 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Belgian users will experience an improved non-deductible VAT process with the introduction of a new global feature. A preconfigured Non-deductible VAT Type field will be available specifically for Belgium. Previously, users selected a general ledger expense account in the Chart of Accounts and manually entered the partial deduction amount in the % Non-deductible VAT field.

title: Try Payables Agent for free without setting up email
summary: Copilot and agents: Try Payables Agent for free without setting up email. Generally available, GA 2026-07 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Payables Agent introduces a free trial mode that any user can start without help from an administrator or having paid credits. You can start the trial directly from the agent setup card or from the Purchase Invoices page. You don't need to have an administrator role or configure an email account. You upload invoice PDFs manually to start processing, bypassing the email-based sourcing flow entirely.

title: Speed up processing with Known Senders in Payables Agent
summary: Copilot and agents: Speed up processing with Known Senders in Payables Agent. Generally available, GA 2026-08 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). This feature introduces email review policy and a Known Senders list page to give accounts payable teams more control over which incoming emails require human approval before the Payables Agent processes them. A new Email review field in the Payables Agent setup lets administrators choose when incoming emails require human approval. The following options are available: Always: Every email requires approval, regardless of the sender.

title: Unlock more Business Central data with MCP server enhancements
summary: Copilot and agents: Unlock more Business Central data with MCP server enhancements. Generally available, GA 2026-06 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). With this update of the MCP server for Business Central, customers and developers can expose a broader set of Business Central APIs as tools, making it easier to build solutions that interact deeply and consistently with Business Central data and processes. Key improvements include: Access to all Microsoft APIs The MCP server can now surface the full set of standard Microsoft APIs in Business Central.

title: Use new APIs for getting the PDF of a document report
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Use new APIs for getting the PDF of a document report. Generally available, GA 2026-06 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). We're introducing read-only APIs in the document report system. The APIs help establish automation on document reporting outside Business Central. For example, to create agents with Microsoft Copilot Studio and MCP Server for Business Central to automate business processes that involve document PDFs.

title: Comply with Australian Payment Times Reporting bill
summary: Country and regional: Comply with Australian Payment Times Reporting bill. Generally available, GA 2026-06 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Every six months, Australian companies with more than AUD100 million in annual turnover must report how and when they pay small business suppliers (suppliers with annual turnover under AUD10 million). This feature organizes vendors by size or payment terms and creates reports that meet local authority requirements. The average agreed payment period. The average actual payment term. The proportion of invoices paid after the agreed payment period.

title: Use payments with the E-Document framework
summary: Electronic documents: Use payments with the E-Document framework. Generally available, GA 2026-08 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). You can mark an e-document as fully paid, partially paid, or unpaid. The system sends this information through accounts payable access points or receives it through accounts receivable access points, based on your e-document configuration.

title: Upload, install, and manage PTEs in the admin center
summary: Governance and administration: Upload, install, and manage PTEs in the admin center. Generally available, GA 2026-07 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Central offers full management of per-tenant extensions (PTEs) in the admin center and through admin center API endpoints. In addition to viewing and uninstalling extensions, administrators can upload PTE packages, install them immediately or schedule installations, and view upcoming extension versions. The API accepts extension package uploads directly, making it easier to integrate with build pipelines and deployment automation.

title: Enable electronic invoicing in France
summary: Country and regional: Enable electronic invoicing in France. Generally available, GA 2026-08 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Central adds support for e-invoicing and e‑reporting in France, following the DGFiP five‑corner model. Microsoft doesn't operate as a certified Partner Dematerialization Platform (PDP); instead, companies can use existing E‑Document connectors to exchange invoices and lifecycle messages through certified PDP providers. The localization app enables two compliant formats: Peppol BIS3 (XML) and Factur‑X (PDF/A‑3 with embedded XML).

title: Sell to business customers on more Shopify plans with B2B company sync
summary: Ecommerce: Sell to business customers on more Shopify plans with B2B company sync. Generally available, GA 2026-07 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Shopify expanded its B2B capabilities to all plans, and the Shopify Connector for Business Central is updated accordingly. Core B2B features that previously required a Shopify Plus subscription now work on Basic, Grow, and Advanced plans. The following capabilities are available on all Shopify plans: Company sync : Import Shopify B2B companies and company locations and map them to customers in Business Central.

title: Use Payment Practices in the UK localization
summary: Country and regional: Use Payment Practices in the UK localization. Generally available, GA 2026-06 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Central extends UK localization to support the updated Reporting on Payment Practices and Performance (Amendment) Regulations 2024 . The system introduces new data points to the existing Payment Practices page, including the total value of payments made during the period, late payments relative to agreed terms, and the percentage of late payments caused by disputes.

title: Use new APIs for analyzing permissions for auditors and IT staff
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Use new APIs for analyzing permissions for auditors and IT staff. Generally available, GA 2026-06 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). In this release wave, we're introducing read-only APIs on the permission system. This allows for establishing security and auditing analytics and reporting outside Business Central—for example, creating reports with Power BI or agents with Microsoft Copilot Studio and MCP Server for Business Central.

title: Calculate taxes for plastic and sugar
summary: Financial Management: Calculate taxes for plastic and sugar. Generally available, GA 2026-07 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Central introduces new capabilities in excise journals to calculate tax amounts for plastic and sugar based on legislation requirements that use weight, content, and transaction quantities as the basis for excise taxes. The new Excise Tax Type , Qty. for Excise Tax , and Excise UOM fields on the Item Card and Fixed Asset Card pages let you define material composition and the relevant quantity basis for each product or fixed asset.

title: Use new APIs for analyzing approval workflows for auditors and IT staff
summary: Reporting and data analysis: Use new APIs for analyzing approval workflows for auditors and IT staff. Generally available, GA 2026-06 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). In this release wave, we're introducing read-only APIs on the (workflow) approval system. This allows for establishing security and auditing analytics and reporting outside Business Central—for example, creating reports with Power BI or agents with Microsoft Copilot Studio and MCP Server for Business Central.

title: Use subcontracting capabilities in production processes
summary: Supply chain management: Use subcontracting capabilities in production processes. Generally available, GA 2026-07 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). The standard Dynamics 365 Business Central solution already meets many global needs. We expand that solution to meet local needs by adding capabilities that include: Logistics flows that manage subcontractor transfers for raw materials and components, along with warehouse handling and item tracking. Flexible pricing that considers the work center, item, dates, and quantity.

title: Use new APIs in Sustainability for better integration
summary: Sustainability Management: Use new APIs in Sustainability for better integration. Generally available, GA 2026-06 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). The feature introduces four new APIs in the Sustainability area to improve interoperability and enable automated data flows between Business Central and external applications. The new APIs are: Goals : Provides read, insert, and modify operations for sustainability goals. ESG Reporting Staging : Read-only API for accessing staged ESG reporting data. Emission Value Entry : Read-only API for retrieving emission value entries calculated in Business Central.

title: Use self-billed invoices
summary: Financial Management: Use self-billed invoices. Generally available, GA 2026-06 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Business Central offers full support for self‑billed invoices in the purchase process. Buyers can now generate invoices on behalf of a vendor when a self‑billing agreement is in place. A new Boolean field on the Vendor Card page enables this agreement, and all Purchase Invoices created for that vendor, whether from Purchase Orders or directly, are automatically marked as self‑billed. Vendors can also be assigned a dedicated No.

title: Use AI resources for your Copilot extensions
summary: Copilot and agents: Use AI resources for your Copilot extensions. In preview, GA 2027-04 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Using the AI resources provides several benefits: Reduced operational overhead : Avoid the need to handle infrastructure management, updates, monitoring, troubleshooting, or maintenance of custom Azure OpenAI subscriptions. This benefit frees up resources to focus on core business operations and provides value-adding intellectual property (IP) to customers.

title: Agent can process vendor credit notes
summary: Payables Agent: Agent can process vendor credit notes. Announced, GA 2026-11 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). Payables Agent can recognize a vendor credit note and produce a purchase credit memo and applies to the original invoice, using the same draft and task experience as invoices. Note: It does not have Return Order matching functionality.

title: Run multiple Sales Order Agents per company with smarter item matching, relevance filtering, and streamlined setup
summary: Copilot and agents: Run multiple Sales Order Agents per company with smarter item matching, relevance filtering, and streamlined setup. Generally available, GA 2026-07 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). You can now configure and run multiple Sales Order Agent instances in a single company. Each instance operates independently with its own mailbox, folder settings, email signature, and processing rules. Each agent instance tracks its own KPI metrics, such as emails received, quotes created, orders created, and time saved.

title: Envision and design AI agents in Business Central
summary: Copilot and agents: Envision and design AI agents in Business Central. In preview, GA 2026-10 (Microsoft 365 roadmap). AI agents in Business Central Business Central introduces AI agents to help users automate repetitive tasks and make business processes more intelligent and efficient. These agents act as specialized assistants that understand context, handle structured data, and collaborate with users to complete end-to-end workflows.

title: Agent permissions intersect the assigner's; agents cannot configure users
summary: An agent is a user, but it cannot configure users or other agents, and it cannot open sensitive pages such as user cards or permission-set assignment. Effective rights are the intersection of the assigning user's permissions and the agent's permission sets.

title: Give the agent a dedicated profile that hides unrelated UI
summary: The agent only sees what its profile shows. Extra actions, views, and Role Center tiles become extra tools and extra tokens. Accuracy and cost both get worse as the UI widens. A human Order Processor profile is usually far too broad.

title: Agent setup pages use ConfigurationDialog and the Agent Setup Part
summary: Instance setup is not a Card or StandardDialog. The toolkit expects PageType = ConfigurationDialog so OK and Cancel are system actions, plus the built-in Agent Setup Part for name, display name, state, and access.

title: Keep the agent setup page source temporary until Update
summary: ConfigurationDialog setup is a draft: the user can Cancel without writing. That only works if SourceTableTemporary = true and custom fields stay in memory until Update. Writing the real table in OnValidate or OnOpenPage commits a partial agent when the dialog errors or is cancelled.

title: Agent setup tables are keyed by User Security ID
summary: Each agent instance is a user. Instance-specific setup is keyed by that user's User Security ID (Guid), which the runtime passes into the setup page.

title: AnalyzeAgentTaskMessage: Error stops the task; Warning still requires review
summary: IAgentTaskExecution.AnalyzeAgentTaskMessage runs on inbound and outbound messages. An Error annotation stops processing. A Warning annotation requests user intervention. If analysis returns Warning, the platform still requires approval even when the incoming message used SetRequiresReview(false).

title: Bind extra agent subscribers only inside an agent session
summary: Page-filter tweaks, extra validation, and prompt dialogs for the agent should not run for every user. Agent Session.IsAgentSession distinguishes agent UI sessions. Binding those subscribers on System Initialization only when the session is an agent session avoids global subscriber cost.

title: Other apps cannot call the toolkit APIs on your agent; publish your own API
summary: For isolation, Agent, Agent Task Builder, and related toolkit codeunits error when the target instance belongs to another app. There is no supported way to pass another extension's metadata provider into SetInstructions or Create. Partners who need to enqueue work must call a public API you own.

title: Do not create agent instances from install, upgrade, or background sessions
summary: Agent.Create requires an interactive user session. The platform blocks creation from install codeunits, upgrade codeunits, and background sessions (job queue, scheduled tasks). Packaging an agent in an app does not mean spinning up instances at install.

title: Default agent permission sets must exist in AL and stay least privilege
summary: IAgentFactory.GetDefaultAccessControls fills a temporary Access Control Buffer used when an instance is created. Permission sets that exist only as user-created sets in a sandbox are missing in the next environment. Granting D365 BUS FULL ACCESS or SUPER gives the agent a user-sized blast radius.

title: The default agent profile must be an AL profile in the app
summary: IAgentFactory.GetDefaultProfile assigns the Role Center and page customizations the agent UI-navigates. A profile built only in the client, or page personalization that was never exported, is absent after deploy.

title: Instruction documents use responsibilities, guidelines, then ordered steps
summary: The runtime treats instructions as the agent's standing prompt. A one-line goal produces inconsistent navigation. Microsoft's instruction framework is three layers: responsibilities (what the agent owns), guidelines (rules for every task), and instructions (ordered steps per task, with substeps).

title: Instructions describe outcomes, not page action or tool names
summary: Agent tools are the UI the profile exposes. Action names and tool ids change across pages and versions. Best-practice guidance is to say what to accomplish, not which tool to invoke. Page state is also not fully in history; values needed later must be memorized.

title: Reapply resource instructions to existing agent instances on upgrade
summary: Static instructions stored as an app resource are copied onto an instance only when you call SetInstructions. Shipping a new Instructions.txt in version 2.0 does not update agents created under 1.0. Models change the resource and assume running instances pick it up.

title: Register a Copilot capability for the agent on install
summary: Each agent type needs a Copilot Capability enum value that the factory links as the feature switch and billing surface. The capability is invisible on Copilot and agent capabilities until an install codeunit calls RegisterCapability when it is not already registered.

title: Set agent instructions as SecretText on the instance
summary: Instructions are instance data, not an enum caption. Agent.SetInstructions takes SecretText so the payload is not logged or copied as ordinary text. A Label or plaintext Text on the agent type is the wrong store: it leaks into telemetry-friendly strings and cannot vary per instance or company.

title: ShowCanCreateAgent only hides UI create, not programmatic create
summary: IAgentFactory.ShowCanCreateAgent controls whether the type appears in the in-client create UI. Returning false does not stop Agent.Create from AL. From 28.1, non-admins can discover extension agents unless this method (and agent configuration rights) restrict them.

title: Skip incoming message review only after the caller validated the payload
summary: Incoming task messages default to requiring user approval before the agent runs. From 28.1, Agent Task Message Builder.SetRequiresReview(false) starts the agent immediately. That is safe only for inputs you already validated in AL (your page action, your posting subscriber).

title: Use the toolkit instruction keywords for review, mail, and memory
summary: The agent runtime looks for specific phrases: ask for assistance, request a review, reply, write an email, memorize, Set field, use lookup, Invoke action. Ordinary English such as get a human to look or remember this is weaker.

title: Wire all three agent interfaces on the metadata provider
summary: An AL agent type is registered by extending Agent Metadata Provider. The platform locates factory, metadata, and task-execution behaviour only through the Implementation property on that enum value.

title: Define profiles as AL objects
summary: Profiles delivered by a Marketplace extension must be declared as AL profile objects. A profile object is validated with its Role Center and page customizations when the extension is compiled and is registered through extension synchronization.

title: Do not hard-code time-zone offsets
summary: Marketplace extensions run for users and services in many time zones. Adding a fixed offset to a DateTime assumes one locale, ignores daylight-saving transitions, and changes an absolute timestamp into an incorrect value for other regions.

title: Keep web-service paths free of UI calls
summary: Pages and codeunits exposed as web services run without an interactive client. Calls that require a UI callback, including Confirm, StrMenu, and modal pages, can terminate the service request instead of completing the operation.

title: Place page extension actions with addfirst or addlast
summary: Place new page-extension actions at the beginning or end of an existing action group with addfirst or addlast.

title: Set UsageCategory on searchable entry points
summary: Pages and reports that users are expected to open directly must set UsageCategory. Without it, the object is absent from Tell Me and users cannot bookmark it from the web client.

title: Use invariant date literals
summary: Write fixed dates in AL with the invariant yyyymmddD syntax. A locale-dependent text value parsed with Evaluate can change meaning or fail under another user's regional settings, which makes the Marketplace extension unreliable across markets.

title: Call Azure OpenAI through the System.AI module, not a hand-built HttpClient request
summary: The System Application's AI module (Azure OpenAI, AOAI Chat Messages, AOAI Chat Completion Params, AOAI Operation Response) is the supported way to call Azure OpenAI from AL. A call made through it is tied to a registered Copilot capability by SetCopilotCapability.

title: Check the AOAI Operation Response before using generated output
summary: GenerateChatCompletion, GenerateTextCompletion, and GenerateEmbeddings in codeunit Azure OpenAI report the outcome of the service call in the AOAI Operation Response passed by var; a failed completion does not stop the AL code.

title: Keep user input and record text out of the system message
summary: AOAI Chat Messages separates roles: the system message (SetPrimarySystemMessage, AddSystemMessage) holds the metaprompt that defines the model's task, output format, and guard rails; user messages (AddUserMessage) carry what the user typed and the business data to work on.

title: Register a Copilot capability on install and on upgrade
summary: Every extension that calls the AI module must register its Copilot Capability enum value with codeunit Copilot Capability; using a capability that the calling extension has not registered raises an error.

title: Save PromptDialog proposals only when the user keeps them
summary: A PromptDialog page shows AI-generated content as a proposal. The user reviews it and then chooses Keep it (systemaction(OK)) or Discard (systemaction(Cancel)), and may regenerate it several times before deciding.

title: AL agents review
summary: Reviews AL source changes against agent guidance from BCQuality.

title: AL Copilot review
summary: Reviews AL source changes that build Copilot features on the System.AI module against Copilot guidance from BCQuality.

title: The File data type's direct I/O methods are OnPrem-only
summary: The classic File variable type — Open/Create/Read/Write/Close against a path on the local or server filesystem — is scoped OnPrem-only.

title: Keep the Copilot help URL to two path levels
summary: The help URL declared in app.json is what Copilot uses to ground answers about your app. That URL may be at most two path levels deep (for example https://contoso.com/docs/myapp).

title: AppSource permission sets must cover setup and usage without SUPER
summary: An AppSource app must provide permission sets that let assigned users complete the app's setup and normal usage without SUPER. The requirement is about complete effective grants, not about naming the permission set after the app.

title: Update the app version at every release
summary: At every release — a branch merged to main, a tagged release build, or an AppSource submission — the app's version is consciously updated, not left to the pipeline alone.

title: Choose access modifiers deliberately
summary: Access is a decision about what you are willing to support forever. The moment a procedure or object is reachable from another extension — no local, or a removed [Scope('OnPrem')] — it becomes a contract: callers bind to it, and changing or removing it later is a breaking change.

title: Deprecate public members through the Obsolete lifecycle, never delete them outright
summary: Deleting or renaming a published procedure (or object) in a single release is a hard break: dependent extensions that reference it stop compiling the moment they pick up the new version, with no warning window to migrate. AL provides staged deprecation so consumers get advance notice.

title: Do not change the signature of a published procedure
summary: A procedure that is reachable from outside its object — any procedure not marked local (and, for on-prem-scoped code, anything a dependent app can still bind to) — is a contract. Once another extension compiles against it, changing its shape breaks that extension at build time.

title: Do not widen access to expose sensitive data through a public API
summary: Every member you make publicly reachable becomes a contract you must keep — and when that member returns a secret, the contract leaks the secret.

title: Do not build on code already marked obsolete
summary: A member carrying [Obsolete], or wrapped in a #if not CLEANxx conditional-compilation block, is already scheduled for deletion — the CLEANxx symbol is flipped on in a future release to strip that code out.

title: Obsolete published table fields instead of deleting, renaming, or renumbering them
summary: A shipped table field carries both a source-level contract and persisted data. Renaming a field while retaining its ID is prohibited by AppSourceCop AS0005 and can break dependent extensions, but it is not inherently a drop-and-readd operation and should not be described as automatic data loss.

title: Send email through the Email module, not Codeunit Mail (397)
summary: Older AL code sends email by calling Codeunit Mail (397).

title: Relocating a field to a tableextension in the same app is not a deletion
summary: Moving a field out of a base-table definition (or a base-app layer modification of one) into a tableextension that extends the same table, within the same app and keeping the same field ID and name, is a relocation — not a deletion or a rename.

title: Changing an unreleased symbol is not a breaking change
summary: Breaking-change rules protect contracts that have already shipped to customers or are exposed to external extensions.

title: Activate a new Price Calculation Handler through OnFindSupportedSetup, not just by implementing it
summary: enum 7011 "Price Calculation Handler" (implements "Price Calculation") is how a new pricing engine plugs into Business Central — extend the enum with a value pointing at a codeunit that implements the Price Calculation interface. That alone does not make the new handler usable on any document.

title: Business state must have a domain owner
summary: Business Central's normal successful finalization removes a non-recurring Job Queue Entry. An exist FlowField over that entry then correctly returns false, even if the handler recorded a business issue that remains unresolved.

title: Calculate a BLOB field before reading its stream
summary: Get, Find, FindSet, and Next do not load the content of Blob fields. Until the field is calculated with CalcFields (or loaded through SetAutoCalcFields before the read), the in-memory BLOB is empty.

title: Enforce `Blocked` where the master is used, not in the master itself
summary: The Blocked field on a master record (Item, Customer, Resource, or a custom master) is inert data. The master table holds no logic that acts on it.

title: Split posting routines into Check Line / Post Line / Post Batch
summary: Business Central's own journal-based posting routines consistently follow a three-codeunit split, each with one primary responsibility — Codeunit "Gen. Jnl.-Check Line" / "Gen. Jnl.-Post Line" / "Gen.

title: Application code must not change the WorkDate
summary: The work date is a per-user session setting the user controls from the client (the date shown in the top-right corner, used to default posting dates and date filters).

title: Custom document dispatch must not bypass Report Selections
summary: A codeunit that hardcodes which report to run (Report.RunModal(MyReportId, ...)), or builds its own email directly, instead of registering the document through table 77 "Report Selections" and calling its own Print/Email procedures, works for the one case it was written for — and loses everything…

title: Delete master and reference data with `Delete(true)` so the owning table's `OnDelete` decides
summary: Record.Delete() and Record.DeleteAll() do not run OnDelete unless RunTrigger is true; the default is false. On a master or reference table, OnDelete is where Business Central decides whether the delete is safe and removes what the record owns.

title: Wire dimension support through DimensionManagement, not ad hoc fields
summary: Adding dimension support to a custom table is not just a matter of adding a Code[20] field, and master tables and document/transactional tables wire into Codeunit "Dimension Management" through two different models — treating them as one mechanism is itself the mistake this article corrects:

title: Never Change a Published Table's Primary or Clustered Key Field List
summary: Once a table has shipped — to AppSource, or to any customer environment that has already upgraded onto it — its primary key, and any other key marked Clustered = true, is frozen.

title: Sales, purchase, and service line prices follow the header's Prices Including VAT
summary: Line prices are gross or net depending on the header's Prices Including VAT. When the flag is set, Unit Price (sales, service), Direct Unit Cost (purchase), Line Amount, Line Discount Amount, Inv. Discount Amount, and the prepayment fields Prepmt. Line Amount, Prepmt. Amt.

title: A document's own Print/Email actions call Report Selections directly; Document Sending Profile is scoped to Post-and-Send
summary: table 60 "Document Sending Profile" is not a general gateway for every print/email path — it exists specifically for the combined Post and Send action: "You can set each customer up with a preferred method of sending sales documents, so that you do not have to select a sending option every time…

title: Extend Find Entries (Navigate) for new document or transaction tables
summary: page 344 Navigate (caption "Find entries") lets a user enter a document number and posting date and see, across every document and ledger entry table BC knows about, how many matching records exist — then drill into any of those rows.

title: Extend Price Source Type and its matching document subset enum together, with the same ID
summary: enum 7003 "Price Source Type" (implements "Price Source", "Price Source Group") is the base list of who a price can apply to — Customer, Vendor, Customer Price Group, Campaign, and so on. It is not, by itself, what drives the "Applies-to Type" field on an actual sales, purchase, or job price list.

title: Register a new document type through Report Selections, and wire it into Document Layouts correctly
summary: A custom document that needs printing/emailing should be registered through table 77 "Report Selections".

title: Initialize document defaults in `InitRecord` after assigning the number
summary: Business Central document headers assign their number series first and then call an InitRecord procedure that owns the remaining business defaults, such as posting and document dates.

title: An insert-only transfer routine may rely on cleanup its caller already performed
summary: A routine that copies rows from a template table into a target table — a TransferX procedure filling comment, dimension, or attribute lines from a standard-task or template record — is frequently written as filter-and-insert with no DeleteAll of its own.

title: After Ship-and-Invoice posting, Item Ledger Entry carries the shipment document number
summary: Posting a sales order with both Ship and Invoice in one call creates the Item Ledger Entry during the shipment leg of that combined post, so the entry's Document No. is stamped with the value assigned to the shipment — Sales Header."Last Shipping No."

title: Create master records with `Insert(true)` unless the caller does the trigger's work itself
summary: Record.Insert() does not run OnInsert: RunTrigger defaults to false. On a standard master table that trigger initializes the record. Unless an OnBeforeInsert subscriber sets IsHandled, Customer.OnInsert assigns No. and No. Series from Sales & Receivables Setup when No.

title: A master table's `No.` primary key comes from a number series in `OnInsert`
summary: In Business Central, a master table (Customer, Vendor, Item, and any custom equivalent) uses a single primary-key field named No. of type Code[20]. It is populated from a number series — configured on the feature's application-area setup table — inside the table's OnInsert trigger, but only when No.

title: A new price source needs both a calculation candidate and a recalculation trigger
summary: Making a custom field usable as a price source on a sales line is two separate, independent pieces of wiring, and doing only one produces a line that looks like it's using the new source without ever actually being priced by it.

title: A table that owns dependent records must delete them in `OnDelete`
summary: TableRelation looks like referential integrity but only performs lookup and input validation. AL has no cascading delete: deleting a parent record leaves every dependent row untouched, and no error is raised.
